methods_quotes.q: Transmission hotspot analysis was conducted using SaTScan software (version 9.6; Harvard Medical School) via spatial scan statistic in a Poisson probability model
The analysis was adjusted for sex and age (<30 years or ≥30 years), and did not allow cluster overlap.
Rates of recent infection were calculated as the number of recent HIV infections per 100,000 persons at risk
Relative risks were calculated as the risk for recent infection among facilities inside a given hotspot compared with the risk outside of the hotspot.
